monospace.usage: Programming cards, timers, XP, stats, terminal outputs

textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to make it feel less flat and more industrial.
Canvas grid should feature metallic tile patterns or a dark grid with glowing intersection points.
surfaces: Use Retro-Futurism/Terminal look for UI panels (deep black backgrounds, high-contrast borders).
Solid flat surfaces for game UI to avoid distraction; NO heavy glassmorphism for programming slots to maintain clarity.
NEVER use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) on panels. Programming slots can have dashed borders when empty.

game_view.desktop: Grid-based with central Canvas (col-span-8 or 9) and sidebar (col-span-4 or 3) for programming cards, health bars, chat.
game_view.mobile: Stack view. Canvas at the top (max 50vh) and programming interface at the bottom (drag & drop touch friendly).

lobby.desktop: Bento Grid (MODE B: High Density). Room lists, chat, and player stats tightly packed with 1px borders.

programming_interface.structure: Horizontal row of 6 empty slots. Below them, a hand of available action cards. Players drag from hand to slots.

cards.style: Flat rectangle with solid dark backgrounds. 1px border. Hover state lifts (-translate-y-1) and glows. When slotted, border turns to success/primary color.

buttons.style: Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Industrial look. Hover: highlight with primary color and add text-shadow.

inputs.style: Flat, bottom border only, or fully enclosed with 1px border. bg-[#1c1c22].

health_bars.style: Segmented blocks (5 PV = 5 blocks). Filled with robot color, empty is dark gray.

ui: Hover states on programming cards (lift and scale slightly).
Countdown timer pulse effect on last 10 seconds.
canvas: Smooth interpolation between grid cells during robot movement.
Shield pulsing (scale 1 to 1.05 with sine wave).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds meets APCA guidelines. Use bright colors for text/icons on dark surfaces.
accessibility.interactions: All draggable elements (cards) must also be selectable via tap/click to slot into the next available space for accessibility.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="card-move-forward"', 'data-testid="slot-1"').

icons.style: Duotone or bold to match industrial theme.

image_urls.description: Dark grey industrial grainy texture for landing page or lobby background.
Robot visualization for the landing page or about section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust 2D Canvas engine for the game board, supporting tile maps, robot entities, lasers, conveyors, and animations.
Implement the Sandbox Admin mode first (priority V1) with step-by-step resolution of 2 robots.
Use Shadcn UI for the Lobby, Wait Room, and Profile, but heavily customize to fit the 'Retro-Futurism/Terminal' look.
Programming interface must support Drag and Drop (use dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd) AND simple click-to-slot fallback.
Implement custom JWT auth and multi-language support (i18n, FR/EN).
Use pure CSS/Tailwind for structural layouts over excessive Shadcn wrappers for complex game views.
You have .js files not .tsx files. ADHERE STRICTLY TO .js/.jsx extensions for React components and files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and ambient glows.
DO NOT use universal transition 'transition: all'.
DO NOT add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for game icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
